entries.title: A short network drop no longer pauses a project's queue
entries.body: Each check of a batch began by downloading the project's whole history with every past version of every file, and a connection that dropped during that download failed the batch and paused the queue. A check now downloads only the history a batch's merges need and the files they read, a fraction of the size. Your first mate offers a project's queue the update.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how a project's queue checks each batch; no screen in the app looks different.
